Taylor Asset Management Has Raised Stake in Canadian Nat Res LTD (CNQ) by $2.81 Million; As Celgene (Put) (CELG) Shares Declined, Laurion Capital Management LP Cut Its Stake by $10.55 Million
May 28, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Benjamin A. Smith decreased its stake in Celgene Corp (Put) (CELG) by 43.52% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Laurion Capital Management Lp sold 101,400 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The hedge fund run by Benjamin A. Smith held 131,600 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.73M, down from 233,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Laurion Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Celgene Corp (Put) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $57.11 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.14% or $0.91 during the last trading session, reaching $78.63. About 6.13M shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 28, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
Taylor Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Canadian Nat Res Ltd (CNQ) by 99.88% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Taylor Asset Management Inc bought 80,300 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.77% with the market. The hedge fund held 160,700 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.78 million, up from 80,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Taylor Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Canadian Nat Res Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $42.13 billion market cap company.
